Initial release of go-btse, an unofficial Go client for BTSE.

- Provides typed Go packages for BTSE public and private REST and WebSocket APIs, including spot, futures, OTC, wallets, and earn products.
- Supports authenticated and public market access; credentials are read from environment variables for private endpoints.
- REST API access is separated by product; method names match OpenAPI operation IDs to avoid conflicts.
- WebSocket support includes spot, futures, and OTC messages.
- Security guidance and usage instructions are included.
- Recommended for Go projects that need BTSE API access or already use github.com/psyb0t/go-btse.
